## Munaciello (CR 2)

A spectral apparition of a lean, emaciated child with sunken eyes, wearing a tattered friar’s robe, flashes for a moment before your eyes. You manage to catch a faint smile on its face before it vanishes again.  

**XP** 600  
CN Small undead (incorporeal)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 14, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)  
**hp** 19 (3d8+6)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +3, **Will** +5  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +4, incorporeal; **Immune** undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 30 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** jinx touch +3 (DC 13)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 3rd; concentration +5)  


At will—invisibility (self only)  


**Bard Spells Known** (CL 3rd; concentration +5)  


1st (4/day)—beguiling gift (DC 13), fool’s gold (DC 14), hideous laughter (DC 13), lucky numberom  

0th (at will)—dancing lights, ghost sound (DC 13), mage hand, mending, prestidigitation (DC 12), open/close  



**Statistics**


Str—, **Dex** 14, Con —, **Int** 13, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +1; **CMD** 13  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Spell Focus (illusion)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Fly +12, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (religion) +7, Perception +8, Sense Motive +8, Stealth +8  
**Languages** Common  


**Special Abilities**



**Jinx Touch (Su)** By passing part of its incorporeal body through a creature’s body as a standard action, a munaciello causes the target to suffer the effects of an evil eye hex, as if used by a 3rd-level witch. The saving throw is Charisma-based.  

**La Smorfia (Sp)** If a munaciello takes a liking to the residents of “its” home, it can leave puzzles and cryptic messages for them that can be interpreted using the 1-to-90 numeric divination system known as La Smorfia. The right numbers to associate to the puzzle can be calculated by succeeding at a DC 25 Knowledge (arcana) or DC 20 Intelligence check. Only one creature can try to interpret each puzzle left by the munaciello; the message then disappears. By interpreting the signs correctly, a creature gains the benefits of a divination spell with 90% effectiveness.  

**Spellcasting** A munaciello casts spells as a 3rd-level bard.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any urban  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** double
